LanguageData.CC_GodM_Sign_Believed: Folk say it is a sign from {GOD}.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Sign_Felt: Some say it is a sign of {GOD}.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_TitleVeiled: The stranger who came to the gate
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Plain_Harmed: {STRANGER} straightened under the blow, and was suddenly taller than anyone there, and not a {TRAVELLER} at all. It was {GOD}, {GODOF}, come to see how this colony treats a stranger at its gate, and {HARMER} raised a hand against {GOD}. The sky went dark, and the god was gone.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Plain_TurnedAway: The {TRAVELLER} the colony turned away stopped on the road, turned, and grew into what they had been all along: {GOD}, {GODOF}. "You had a bed to spare, and you know it," the god said, and walked on.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Plain_Poor: At the gate {STRANGER} stopped, turned, and was {GOD}, {GODOF}, as plain as day. "A cold welcome is still a welcome," the god said, without warmth, "but only just."
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Plain_Fair: At the gate {STRANGER} stopped, turned, and was {GOD}, {GODOF}, taller than the wall and bright as noon. "You did right by me, near enough," the god said, "and I'll remember it."
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Plain_Kind: At the gate {STRANGER} stopped, turned, and grew into {GOD}, {GODOF}, while everyone watched. "I came as a stranger, and you treated me as one of your own," the god said. "That is the whole of the law, and you kept it."
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Plain_Generous: At the gate {STRANGER} stopped, turned, and grew into {GOD}, {GODOF}, and the light came off the god like heat off a hearth. "A bed, a table, and kindness besides," the god said. "Few houses have given me all three. This one will be remembered."
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Veiled_Harmed: One moment {STRANGER} was there, struck and bleeding; the next there was only scorched ground, and the sky had gone dark. Some say the {TRAVELLER} was {GOD}, and that {HARMER} will pay for that blow.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Veiled_TurnedAway: The {TRAVELLER} the colony turned away is gone, and the road where they walked is scorched. Some say it was {GOD}, come to see who opens a door and who doesn't.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Veiled_Poor: The {TRAVELLER} {STRANGER} is gone, and nobody saw them leave the land. Some say it was {GOD}, and that the god was not much pleased with what it found.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Veiled_Fair: The {TRAVELLER} {STRANGER} is gone, and nobody saw them leave the land. Some say it was {GOD}, and that it found the colony fair enough.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Veiled_Kind: The {TRAVELLER} {STRANGER} is gone, and where they slept there's a warmth in the ground. Some say it was {GOD}, and that the god was glad of its welcome here.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Veiled_Generous: The {TRAVELLER} {STRANGER} is gone before anyone was up, and where they slept the ground has answered. Some say it was {GOD} itself, and that few houses have welcomed it so well.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Kindest: {KINDEST} was kindest of all, and the god has not forgotten it.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Act_Harmed: came to the gate as a {TRAVELLER}, and was struck
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Act_TurnedAway: came to the gate as a {TRAVELLER}, and was turned away
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Act_Poor: came to the gate as a {TRAVELLER}, and was poorly kept
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Act_Fair: came to the gate as a {TRAVELLER}, and was fairly kept
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Act_Kind: came to the gate as a {TRAVELLER}, and was kindly kept
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Act_Generous: came to the gate as a {TRAVELLER}, and was welcomed like family
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Memory_Stranger: the {TRAVELLER} who came to the gate
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Chronicle_Stranger: {GOD} {WHAT}, and at the end showed itself for what it was.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Chronicle_StrangerVeiled: A {TRAVELLER} came to the gate and went, and some say it was {GOD}.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Why_Harmed: its {TRAVELLER} was struck at the colony's gate
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Why_TurnedAway: its {TRAVELLER} was turned away from the gate
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Gift_Spell: a scroll of {THING}, left at their feet
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Gift_Favour: the favour of {GOD}, and a spark of inspiration
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Journal_Gift: The stranger was more than a stranger, and I was given {WHAT}. I don't know why me.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Out_Fever: {PAWN_nameDef}, who raised a hand against {GOD}, has come down with a fever.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Out_NoRain: The rain keeps away from the colony's fields.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Out_DryThunder: Dry thunder walks over the colony.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Out_GameGone: The wild game has gone from the land.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Out_Fires: The colony's lights gutter and won't stay lit.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Weather_Aurora: {GOD} lit the night sky for the colony
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Omen_Birds: Every bird on the land around {HOME} took off at once and flew away.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Omen_Calm: A strange calm has fallen over {HOME}: the wind has died, and nothing moves.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Omen_Candle: A light at {HOME} won't stay lit, though there's no draft.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Omen_Restless: The animals at {HOME} are restless: they start, run, and stand looking the same way.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Omen_Dream: {PAWN_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} woke from the same dream: "{DREAM}"
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_Text: A {BEAST} has come in from the edge of the land, larger than any of its kind and lit from within: {GOD}, {GODOF}, walking as a beast. It will stay a few days. Leave it be, feed it or follow it where it leads; whoever hurts it hurts a god.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_TextVeiled: A {BEAST} has come in from the edge of the land, larger than any of its kind, with a light about it that the dusk doesn't dim. Some say it is {GOD} walking as a beast. It won't let anyone tame it, and nobody wants to be the one who hunts it.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_Act: walked the colony's land as a {BEAST}
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Boon_Text: {PAWN_nameDef} followed {GOD} across the land, the {BEAST} looking back now and then to see that {PAWN_pronoun} still came. Where it stopped, it gave.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Boon_TextVeiled: {PAWN_nameDef} followed the {BEAST} across the land, and it looked back now and then to see that {PAWN_pronoun} still came. Some say it was {GOD} leading, and where it stopped, it gave.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Boon_Vein: It stopped by a seam of {ORE} in the rock that nobody had seen before.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_LedAct: led {PAWN} across the land as a {BEAST}, and gave where it stopped
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Memory_Animal: the {BEAST} that was more than a beast
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Journal_Led: I followed the {BEAST} today, and I don't know how to say what it was.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Why_LeftBe: its {BEAST} walked the land and was left in peace
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Why_Hurt: its {BEAST} was hurt by the colony
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Why_Slain: its {BEAST} was slain by the colony
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Sacrilege_Text: {HARMER} drew blood from the {BEAST}, and the {BEAST} was {GOD}. The sky has gone dark over the colony, and the god's anger is on it.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Sacrilege_TextVeiled: {HARMER} drew blood from the {BEAST}, and the sky went dark as it bled. Some say the {BEAST} was {GOD}, and that the colony will answer for it.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_HurtAct: was hurt by {PAWN} while it walked the land as a {BEAST}
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_SlainAct: was slain while it walked the land as a {BEAST}
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_Gone: {GOD} has left the land, and the {BEAST} with it.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_GoneVeiled: The {BEAST} has gone from the land as quietly as it came. Some say it was {GOD}.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_GoneHurt: {GOD} has left the land in anger, and the wounded {BEAST} with it.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_GoneHurtVeiled: The wounded {BEAST} is gone, and nobody saw where. Some say it was {GOD}, and that it won't forget.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_GoneAct: left the colony's land as a {BEAST}
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Menu_Hurt: it was hurt, and won't come near anyone
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Menu_NoFood: nothing in the stores a {KIND} would eat
LanguageData.CC_GodM_MarkAct: left its mark on the land at {HOME}
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Journal_Mark: I went out to the place where {GOD} {WHAT}, and stood there a while.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Week_StrangerAtGate: {STRANGER}, a {TRAVELLER}, is waiting at the gate
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Week_StrangerByGate: {STRANGER}, a {TRAVELLER}, is sleeping by the gate
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Week_StrangerSub: a stranger who asked for shelter
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Week_AnimalVeiled: a {KIND} like no other walks the land
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Week_AnimalSub: leave it be, feed it, or follow it
